title: Heavenly Secrets Reveal Their Omen
next_chapter_hook: Three paths of destiny have appeared. In Chen Ji's hands lies not merely the Tianji Record, but the life and death of all involved—and Su Qingyao's gaze pierces through countless illusions, reaching straight to the deepest depths of his heart.

text.content: A dimensional rift tears open before Chen Ji's eyes, and that eye transcending the limits of cognition slowly rotates. The scene reflected in its pupil shakes his soul to its core—it is countless threads of destiny intertwined into an enormous web, and he, Chen Ji, is merely an insignificant node within it. "Is this... the complete form of the Heavenly Eye?" he murmurs softly, his voice ephemeral and fragile amid the dimensional chaos. The Tianji Record Fragment trembles violently, golden runes squirming across its pages like living creatures, as if trying to break free from some shackle. Su Qingyao stands half a step behind him, her delicate hand gripping the sword hilt so tightly her knuckles have gone white. She can sense the unprecedented紊乱 in Chen Ji's aura, as if something is about to break free from its cocoon.

At this moment, the Tianji Record suddenly erupts with blinding brilliance. Not the fragmented, incomplete light, but a complete, perfect radiance—as if countless scattered pages have finally found their destined home, merging as one under the crucible of dimensional pressure. Chen Ji's pupils contract sharply; he can clearly perceive the transformation of the Tianji Record within his Mental Sea: the 129,600 runes no longer incomplete, but forming a perfect closed loop. "The complete Tianji Record... actually completed under such circumstances?" he screams within his heart, yet feels no joy, for the price of the complete Tianji Record, he knows better than anyone—every activation is a frenzied devouring of his Heavenly Fate. Mo Xiansheng's remnant soul voice rings in his mind: "It has awakened... the will of the Tianji Record has finally awakened completely."

The Tianji Record opens itself, and three distinctly different visions of destiny emerge on the golden pages. Chen Ji takes a deep breath, forcing himself tocalm下来scrutinizing这三条最终之路。In the first vision, he sees a ragged mortal walking along a country path, with no spiritual energy around him, yet laughing with unprecedented ease. In the second vision, he sits upon a throne woven from countless destiny threads, overlooking all living beings, yet his eyes are terrifyingly empty. In the third vision, he faces that Heavenly Eye, both shattering simultaneously into countless starlight, nourishing the earth beneath. "Path One: break the chains and become free, but lose divine power... Path Two: replace Heaven and become the chess player, but be forever alone... Path Three: mutually destroy with Heaven, exchanging it for all things reborn..." Chen Ji's voice trembles.

"These three paths..." Chen Ji's voice stops abruptly, because the price of the first path is written clearly in the Tianji Record—lose all abilities granted by the Tianji Record, return to the most ordinary mortal. For a strategist who once calculated without miss, this is more terrifying than death. "I have memorized it." He recites silently in his heart, yet his eyes show not the slightest waver, "But before making a decision, I need to know all the prices."

dialogue.content: "Chen Ji! Your Heavenly Fate is draining frantically!" Su Qingyao's voice comes from behind, carrying rare panic, "Over three hundred points have been consumed since just now!" Her delicate hand finally leaves the sword hilt, trembling as it presses against Chen Ji's shoulder, attempting to stabilize his foundation with her own spiritual energy.

text.content: Chen Ji turns to look at her, the light from the rift illuminating their faces intermittently. He suddenly laughs, and in that smile Su Qingyao sees a vulnerability she has never witnessed before: "Qingyao, if I become atrash, an absolutetrash... would you..." He doesn't finish, because he sees Su Qingyao's gaze suddenly sharpen, as if something has been completely ignited.

The light of the first path gradually dims, as if awaiting his final choice. Meanwhile, the light of the second path begins to slowly流转, countless scenes flickering within it—he sees Ye Qing standing behind him, yet sealed by his own hands; sees Ling Yuan kneeling at his feet, yet ignored by him; sees the entire world operating on his chessboard, yet without a single true friend. He violently closes his eyes: "This path... is not what I want." Mo Xiansheng's voice rings again: "Then what about the third path? Do you dare to look?"

The core scene of the third path finally blooms completely upon the Tianji Record—it is an earth-shattering confrontation, Chen Ji and the Heavenly Eye fighting desperately in the dimensional夹缝, every blow causing the heavens to tremble. Yet finally, both become simultaneously void. The price written clearly: Heavenly Fate becomes zero, physical body annihilated, divine soul shattered. "Mutually destroy with Heaven..." Chen Ji murmurs, yet his voice carries no fear, but rather a sense of relief, "This is the true fatal counterattack, isn't it?"

dialogue.content: "Don't you dare!" Su Qingyao's voice suddenly rises, she grabs Chen Ji's collar and pulls his entire body toward her, "Chen Ji, you listen to me clearly—if you dare die, I'll die together with you!" Her眼眶泛红, the mask of coldness completely shattered, revealing the person beneath who loves him deeply, "You think I don't know? You think I can't see through your schemes? I know everything, yet I've never said a word, because I..."

text.content: The dimensional rift begins to violently contract, that Heavenly Eye's gaze becoming increasingly clear, as if the next moment it will穿透一切屏障降临此处. Chen Ji knows he has no time left—the complete Tianji Record has revealed three paths, but each requires him to take the first step himself. And now, his Heavenly Fate has fallen to the dangerous red line's edge. Su Qingyao's tears fall onto his手背, warm and heavy. Mo Xiansheng's voice rings at this moment, carrying a warmth Chen Ji has never heard before: "Child, you have another choice—not any of the three paths, but to create your own fourth path."

dialogue.content: "A fourth path?" Chen Ji abruptly raises his head, his eyes emitting unprecedented brilliance, "How?" Mo Xiansheng is silent for a moment, then slowly speaks: "Break the rules set by Heaven, let destiny no longer be a one-way street." On the Tianji Record, the outline of the fourth path begins to faintly emerge—a path no one has ever walked, its price and rewards both unknown. "So this is..." Chen Ji murmurs, a familiar curve appearing at the corner of his mouth, "This is the answer I wanted."

text.content: On the Tianji Record, the fourth path's phantom becomes increasingly clear. Its outline is not as definite as the first three, but constantly changing, constantly evolving, as if containing infinite possibilities. Chen Ji stares at that faintly discernible path, his heart surging with unprecedented悸动. This path has no set price, no clear endpoint—it is a blank sheet of paper, awaiting him to personally write his own destiny. "Interesting..." he laughs softly, his eyes filling with mounting anticipation, "This is the true chess game." The dimensional rift begins to frantically contract, the Heavenly Eye's gaze imminent, Chen Ji knows he must choose immediately.

"Four paths lie before me..." Chen Ji's voice echoes through the dimensional storm, he slowly surveys each path's phantom, finally fixing his gaze upon that constantly changing fourth path, "I, Chen Ji, have walked this world for so many years, never following paths others have drawn for me." He takes a deep breath, reaching toward that faintly discernible outline, "Since Heaven wants me to choose, then I choose—the Fourth Path!" The Tianji Record suddenly erupts with blinding brilliance, as if cheering for his choice. Su Qingyao tightly grasps his hand, stepping together toward that unknown destiny. The dimensional rift closes thunderously behind them, the Heavenly Eye's gaze temporarily blocked outside.

The fourth path extends beneath Chen Ji's feet, and along its sides, countless light points emerge in the darkness—those are his schemes, his pieces, every destiny node he has influenced. Ye Qing's demonic path mist looms within, concealing his heavenly secret aura; Ling Yuan's ambition stirs within, becoming a dark piece on his chessboard; Han Lie's brute force咆哮 within, forming a mirror opposition to his strategies. And Su Qingyao, tightly holding his hand, stepping together toward that unknown future. Chen Ji glances back at her, a familiar curve appearing at the corner of his mouth: "Since we're taking the fourth path, we must make it follow my rules. Qingyao, are you ready?" Su Qingyao says nothing, only gripping his hand tighter. The dimensional storm transforms into a smooth path beneath their feet, and the chess game of destiny officially begins to rewrite itself.

dialogue.content: "What are you hesitating about?" Su Qingyao's voice comes from behind, cold yet carrying an unnoticeable tremor, "Whatever you choose, I will..." Her words戛然而止, as if something话到嘴边又咽了回去. Chen Ji turns to look at her, the intense light from the dimensional rift illuminating her face like a deity descended to earth, yet those cold eyes are now churning with emotions she has never shown before. "Qingyao, what were you trying to say?"

Chen Ji looks into her eyes, suddenly laughs. That smile contains none of his usual scheming or pretense, only arelieved of having seen through everything: "You want to say, you'll accompany me?" He reaches out, gently brushing away a tear at the corner of Su Qingyao's eye, his gesture so tender it doesn't resemble that cold废材disciple at all, "Fool, once this path is stepped upon, there's no room for回头." He turns back, facing those three paths of destiny, his voice low yet firm, "But since you're already prepared... I won't let you down."

text.content: The three paths slowly rotate before Chen Ji, each emanating distinctly different auras. The first path's runes are the most gentle, yet exuding a chilling衰败sense; the second path's runes are the most brilliant, yet emanating bone-piercing coldness; the third path's runes are the most violent, as if about to explode and destroy everything at any moment. Yet Chen Ji's gaze always remains on that unilluminated dark void beyond the three paths. "Mo Xiansheng," he calls in his heart, "the fourth path you speak of... what exactly is it?" Mo Xiansheng's remnant soul is silent for a moment, then lets out a sigh: "The reason the Tianji Record is fragmented is because it was deliberately divided into four parts. The Heavenly Eye knows only three of them, and the fourth... has always been hidden within you."

Chen Ji's pupils contract sharply, an unprecedented power surges from the depths of his bloodline. It is neither spiritual energy nor divine consciousness, but something more fundamental—his own "Heavenly Fate." The fourth fragment of the Tianji Record awakens within him, resonating with the other three pieces, four beams of light intertwining to weave a brand new path in the void. "So that's how it is..." Chen Ji laughs softly, his voice carrying a hint of mad battle intent, "So from the very beginning, I was never Heaven's chess piece." He turns to face that Heavenly Eye, his gaze cold as frost, "But rather, the one who moves the pieces."

dialogue.content: "The one who moves the pieces?" Su Qingyao freezes, then snaps back to reality, grabbing Chen Ji's arm, "You're insane! This means you'll directly oppose Heaven!" Her voice trembles, yet her eyes burn with the same brilliance as Chen Ji, "Do you think you can do it alone?" Chen Ji lowers his head to look at her, suddenly pulling her into his embrace, whispering near her ear: "Not alone. Never alone."

text.content: Su Qingyao's body stiffens. This is the first time Chen Ji has touched her so主动ly, she can feel the warmth of his chest, the rhythm of his heartbeat, and the weight contained in those words. "You..." Her voice chokes, not knowing what to say. Chen Ji releases her, turns to face that brand new path illuminated by his own Heavenly Fate, a familiar curve appearing at the corner of his mouth: "Let's go, Qingyao. Since Heaven has prepared three sets of dishes for us, let's flip the table and set our own."

Just then, the Tianji Record suddenly vibrates violently, the three predetermined paths of destiny distort abruptly, transforming into three chains sweeping toward Chen Ji. "It wants to force my choice!" Chen Ji's gaze sharpens, yet shows no panic, "Is this Heaven's means?" He raises his right hand, the power of the fourth fragment within him surging forth, colliding directly with those three chains. In an instant, the entire dimensional space trembles violently under this collision of forces. Su Qingyao grips her long sword tightly, standing shoulder to shoulder with him: "I said long ago—if you fight, I fight!"

The three chains and Chen Ji's Heavenly Fate power激烈交锋in mid-air, each blow scattering countless dimensional fragments. That Heavenly Eye's pupil contracts sharply, as if for the first time truly "seeing" Chen Ji. "Interesting..." Chen Ji grins, revealing a dangerous smile, "So you can be afraid too." He suddenly increases his output, the fourth fragment's power surging forth like a breached dam, shattering all three chains completely, "Then let me show you—what is the true Heavenly Secrets!" The Tianji Record transforms in his hand into a golden sword, its blade engraved with runes transcending current understanding.

The dimensional space begins to collapse under the golden sword's pressure, that Heavenly Eye's gaze becoming unprecedentedly grave. Su Qingyao gazes at Chen Ji's back at this moment, suddenly understanding why she was attracted to this "trash"—not because of his scheming, not because of his layouts, but because beneath that weak exterior lies a heart that never surrenders. "I果然没有看错人." She whispers, a faint smile appearing at the corner of her mouth, then draws her sword: "Since we're fighting, then—fight together!" Two figures stand shoulder to shoulder, one a strategist wielding the Heavenly Secrets sword, the other the Inner Sect's number one sword cultivation genius. On destiny's chessboard, the pieces finally begin to rebel against the one who moves them.

The golden long sword intertwined with Su Qingyao's sword light, forming a brilliant pillar of light that stabbed straight into that Eye of Heavenly Way. The dimensional space completely collapsed under this strike, and the three—or rather two people and one transcendent consciousness—fell simultaneously into an even deeper Void. Chen Ji felt his Heavenly Fate Value draining at an alarming rate, but he did not retreat. Instead, he gripped the sword hilt tighter. "This strike is a greeting gift for the Heavenly Way!" His voice echoed through the Void, carrying a nearly manic joy. "The next time we meet, it will be your fall!" The Eye of Heavenly Way let out a soundless roar, yet from the depths of its pupil flickered a trace of... fear?

When everything returned to peace, Chen Ji found himself lying on a soft patch of grass. Su Qingyao sat beside him, her long sword resting across her knees, gazing quietly at him. "We... came back?" He struggled to sit up, only to discover his limbs were sore and weak—the Heavenly Fate Value consumed by that previous strike far exceeded his imagination. Mo Xiansheng's voice rang out in his mind: "You succeeded. Though you didn't defeat the Heavenly Way, you broke its rules." After a pause, he added: "Of course, the cost was also great. Your Heavenly Fate Value is now less than one hundred points."

dialogue.content: "One hundred points..." Chen Ji repeated softly, yet a smile curled at the corner of his mouth. "That's enough." He turned to look at Su Qingyao, who was gazing at him with complex eyes—worry, heartache, and a certain emotion he couldn't read. "What are you looking at?" he asked with feigned lightness. Su Qingyao was silent for a moment, then spoke slowly: "You just said I'm not alone. Never have been... what did you mean?" Chen Ji was stunned, then revealed a genuine smile—not scheming, not a pretense, but a real smile belonging to Chen Ji: "Exactly what I said."

text.content: Su Qingyao's eyes reddened again, but she stubbornly turned her head away, not letting Chen Ji see her vulnerability. Chen Ji didn't expose her either, simply lying quietly on the grass, gazing at the long-missed blue sky above. The complete version of the Tianji Record still lay in his embrace, emitting a faint glow, as if awaiting the next awakening. "The fourth path has opened..." he silently organized his experience just now, "but this is only the beginning. The Heavenly Way won't let this rest, and my Heavenly Fate Value..." He didn't continue thinking, knowing that sometimes thinking too much would affect judgment.

Mo Xiansheng's voice suddenly rang out again: "Chen Ji, there is something I must tell you." The tone was more solemn than ever before. Chen Ji frowned slightly: "Speak." Mo Xiansheng was silent for a moment, then spoke slowly: "The fourth fragment of the Tianji Record exists in your body because... your sister, Chen Nian." Chen Ji's body froze abruptly—she was his only blood relative in this world. "What happened to Niannian?" His voice suddenly turned ice-cold. "You'd better give me an explanation." Mo Xiansheng sighed: "She is not an ordinary Heavenly Fate Key—she is the true source of the power within you."

Chen Ji abruptly sat up, an unprecedented killing intent flickering in his eyes: "What did you say?" Mo Xiansheng's voice continued, unhurried: "When the Tianji Record split into four fragments back then, the fourth one—which carried the 'self-will'—was separated and injected into a special person. That person is Chen Nian. She was taken by the Holy Sect not because she was a Heavenly Fate Key, but because... she is the source of your power. Or rather, she is the true Tianji Record." Chen Ji's hands tightly clenched into fists, his knuckles white from force. Su Qingyao sensed the change in his emotions and silently took his hand, offering him silent support.

"So..." Chen Ji's voice was terrifyingly low, "if the Heavenly Way wants to control me, it must first control Niannian?" Mo Xiansheng was silent for a moment: "That could be said. But conversely, if you want to completely break free from the Heavenly Way's control..." He didn't finish, but Chen Ji already understood his meaning—he must find Chen Nian, not only for sibling reunion, but to master his own destiny. "Holy Sect..." Chen Ji murmured this name, a dangerous light flickering in his eyes, "looks like it's time to pay them a visit." He turned to look at Su Qingyao, his eyes恢复了往日的清明与calculating：「青瑶，帮我传个消息给夜清——告诉她，我需要她的魔道迷雾。」

Su Qingyao nodded, yet there was no hesitation in her eyes: "You're going to make a move on the Holy Sect?" Chen Ji stood up, brushing grass clippings off his clothes, a familiar curve appearing at the corner of his mouth: "Not a move—arrangement. The Holy Sect wants to threaten me using Niannian, then I'll let them know what it means to have flawless strategy." He turned to gaze at the distant horizon, where thunderclouds faintly gathered, as if the Heavenly Way was warning against his audacity, "This time, it's not my chess game alone." Su Qingyao walked to his side, standing shoulder to shoulder with him: "I always said, if you fight, I fight." Chen Ji glanced at her sideways, suddenly laughing: "Su Qingyao, you're good in every way, only you're too earnest."

"What's wrong with being earnest?" Su Qingyaoscoffed coldly一声，却没有移开目光，「总比你这个满嘴谎言的骗子强。」 Chen Jiwas momentarily stunned，随即放声大笑——这是他来到这个世界后，笑得最畅快的一次。「说得好。」他伸手，轻轻弹了一下苏青瑶的额头，「那从今天起，我就只对你一个人说真话。」苏青瑶的脸颊slightly泛红，但她依然stubborn地抬起下巴：「那我等着。」两人相视而笑，仿佛方才那场惊心动魄的对决不过是一场梦。但他们都清楚，真正的战斗，才刚刚开始。
